acquisition.instrumented_wall_scope: Sum of collector lifetimes after Client creation, including input/rate waits; excludes inter-process diagnosis/cooldown, startup/config parsing and final ledger write. The request window separately includes gaps between attempts.
acquisition.instrumented_cpu_scope: Process user+system CPU through shutdown, summed across attempts, including interpreter startup but excluding final ledger write. No editor, test, dependency-installation, review or human-effort cost is included.
execution_adjustments: First timeout stopped acquisition. Waited at least 300 seconds after timeout before the deliberate continuation; excluded two historically documented bot handles without replacement.

Two local parser failures required two additional fresh logins beyond revision 2 login_attempts=2, recorded in Beads before each continuation. One successful but uncached page was repeated once; its cached successor was reused thereafter.
All continuations consumed original cumulative 500-request, 100-MiB, 60-minute, 900-CPU-second budgets and unchanged UTC deadline. No further network error occurred.

separate_authenticated_probe.note: CPU and total setup/input wall time not recorded in this request ledger; body content and query values were not persisted.

other_cost_scopes.unauthenticated_preflight: 12 direct checks, 110965 response bytes, separately recorded in the prior preflight manifest.
other_cost_scopes.github_discovery: Three public GitHub API responses supplied repository/source/survey evidence; outside the KGS request and byte totals. CPU/wall/byte totals for web search and these checks were not instrumented.
other_cost_scopes.human_effort: Owner supplied access credentials and a load constraint. Participation, owner time and agent/review wall time were not measured; no recruited human matches or training.

code_provenance.note: Capture-time source hashes are in each available run record. Later offline checks added inaccessible-row/date/cache validation without changing the selected frame/sample; the final code reproduces the audit from retained inputs. Old capture source bytes are not distributed separately.
